test_title: PYST 10: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

Rohit said that he would save me from been scold by father.
solution:
The erroneous part is **'been scold'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence implies that the action of scolding will be occurring in the future and the subject will be saved from it by someone called Rohit.
